series.synopsis: Miyano spends his days peacefully reading Boys' Love comics and worrying about how girly his face is-until a chance encounter leads to a scuffle with his senior Sasaki. Intrigued by his feisty junior Miyano, delinquent Sasaki uses every opportunity he can to get closer...

series.title: Seaside Stranger: Umibe no Étranger
series.author: Kanna Kii
series.synopsis: "There's nothing wrong with liking another guy." To be in the arms of the person I love... I thought that was an unobtainable dream......... On an island off the coast of Okinawa, two young men meet on a beach. Shun Hashimoto is gay and aspires to be a novelist.

series.title: World Trigger
series.author: Daisuke Ashihara
series.synopsis: A gate to another dimension has burst open, and from it emerge gigantic invincible creatures that threaten all of humanity. Earth's only defense is a mysterious group of warriors who have co-opted the alien technology in order to fight back!

series.title: Snow White with the Red Hair
series.author: Sorata Akizuki
series.synopsis: Shirayuki is famous for her naturally bright-red hair, and the prince of Tanbarun wants her all to himself! But when she escapes into the woods of the neighboring kingdom, a young man named Zen and his two friends come to her aid.

series.title: Bocchi the Rock!
series.author: Aki Hamaji
series.synopsis: Hitori Gotoh just wants to be popular, but the thought of interacting with her classmates makes her fall to pieces. Her solution-become a rock legend so cool that people approach her instead! However, while spending all of middle school in her closet shredding on the guitar may…

series.title: Berserk of Gluttony
series.author: Ichika Isshiki & Daisuke Takino
series.synopsis: Fate Graphite has never tasted true power. Born into a world with two kinds of people—those with superior skills and those without—he’s been shunned his entire life. Fate’s skill is Gluttony, a curse that leaves him constantly hungry… until he awakens its terrible potential.

series.title: Go For It, Nakamura!
series.author: Shundei
series.synopsis: Nakamura is a shy boy who falls in love at first sight with one of his classmates–his dreamy high school classmate, Hirose. But there's a problem: they haven't met yet. And Nakamura is a total klutz who might bungle things before they even begin!

series.title: My Senpai is Annoying
series.author: Shiromanta & Lys Blakeslee
series.synopsis: Igarashi is a hardworking young office lady. Takeda, the senpai above her at work, annoys her constantly–and yet she finds herself growing closer to him. Every day is filled with comic mishaps and romantic moments as Igarashi tries to balance work, life, and love.

series.title: Kowloon Generic Romance
series.author: Jun Mayuzuki
series.synopsis: Welcome to Kowloon Walled City: a dystopian townscape where the people are brimming with nostalgia, and where the past, present, and future converge.

series.title: Marriage Toxin
series.author: Joumyaku & Mizuki Yoda
series.synopsis: A hitman and a marriage swindler set out on the world’s most grueling battle for marriage! Gero is a young man from a clan of hitmen, which has been in existence for hundreds of years.

series.title: I Want to End This Love Game
series.author: Yuuki Doumoto
series.synopsis: The first step to winning the Love Game is saying “I love you.” So how do you lose? By admitting you’re in love! Let the games begin! Since childhood, Yukiya Asagi and Miku Sakura have played the Love Game, where they try to fluster each other with a simple “I love you.” But…

series.title: I Can't Say No to the Lonely Girl
series.author: Kashikaze
series.synopsis: In this juicy yuri manga, the goody-goody high school girl Sakurai meets a lonely girl—and ends up entangled in a web of blackmail that might just lead to romance.

series.title: your name.
series.author: Ranmaru Kotone & Makoto Shinkai
series.synopsis: A story of two people determined to hold on to one another. Mitsuha, a high school girl from a town deep in the mountains, dreams of an unfamiliar life in Tokyo. Taki, a high school boy from Tokyo, dreams that he is a girl living in the mountains.

series.title: Spirit Circle
series.author: Satoshi Mizukami
series.synopsis: Fuuta Okeya’s dad said second-year middle school students are unstoppable, and he’s inclined to agree. Fuuta’s determined to make the most out of his ordinary student life, but everything changes when the mysterious Kouko Ishigami transfers into his class.

series.title: Love Bullet
series.author: inee
series.synopsis: In this contemporary world, Cupids solve problems of love not with bows and arrows but with guns! However, when the Cupids get in an argument over how to solve a love triangle…a full on shoot-out occurs?!

series.title: The Ice Guy and the Cool Girl
series.author: Miyuki Tonogaya
series.synopsis: Sparks fly between the handsome descendant of a snow spirit and the oblivious coworker he has a crush on! A romantic comedy in an office setting that takes coworkers to lovers to new heights within a winter wonderland of emotions! Himuro is a modern-day ice god, an ordinary…

series.title: No Matter How I Look at It, It's You Guys'…
series.author: Nico Tanigawa
series.synopsis: Kuroki Tomoko is a super popular, high school girl, who has had 50 years of dating experience, and 100 boys... in the Otome game world. In the real world, she is a 15 year old shut in, who has all of the qualities of a "mojo" (喪女, a gloomy or unpopular woman).

series.title: Sensei wa Koi wo Oshierarenai
series.author: Motomi Minamoto
series.synopsis: A lazy student and a straight-laced teacher. At first glance, they seem like they are on bad terms, but things get different after classes...

series.title: Shaman King
series.author: Hiroyuki Takei
series.synopsis: Shamans possess mysterious powers that allow them to commune with gods, spirits, and even the dead…and Manta Oyamada's about to learn all about them, because his class just welcomed a new transfer student: Yoh Asakura, a boy from way off in Izumo…and a shaman in training! Note:…

series.title: Cardcaptor Sakura
series.author: CLAMP
series.synopsis: Fourth grader Sakura Kinomoto finds a strange book in her father's library -- a book made by the wizard Clow to store dangerous spirits sealed within a set of magical cards.

series.title: Wistoria: Wand and Sword
series.author: Fujino Oomori & Toshi Aoi
series.synopsis: Will Serfort dreams of keeping his promise to a childhood friend by becoming a Magia Vander, one of the mighty magicians who sit atop the Wizard's Tower.

series.title: Welcome to the N.H.K.
series.author: Tatsuhiko Takimoto & Kenji Ooiwa
series.synopsis: Sato Tatsuhiro is a drug-addled "hikikomori" (a Japanese shut-in) who thinks a sinister organization, NHK (Nihon Hikikomori Kyoukai), is the cause of all his problems! He falls in love with a girl, Misaki, who he thinks is trying to assassinate him, but doesn't know how to talk…

series.title: Doubt
series.author: Yoshiki Tonogai
series.synopsis: Rabbit Doubt-a mobile phone game-has taken Japan by storm. In it, players are rabbits who must uncover the wolf in rabbit's clothing before falling prey to its mistrust-sowing wiles...as well as its teeth.

series.title: Karakai Jouzu no (Moto) Takagi-san
series.author: Souichirou Yamamoto & Mifumi Inaba
series.synopsis: The (former) Takagi-san and her daughter, Chi-chan, bring you this teasing home comedy. Is Dad going to make an appearance too?

series.title: Tune In to the Midnight Heart
series.author: Masakuni Igarashi
series.synopsis: When Arisu Yamabuki was all alone in bed at night, he was able to find solace in the voice of a radio host who went by “Apollo.” However, one day, she simply stopped broadcasting without any explanation. Years then passed, and Arisu is now a second-year high-schooler.

series.title: Battle Royale
series.author: Koushun Takami & Masayuki Taguchi
series.synopsis: Under the guise of a "study trip," a group of students from Shiroiwa Junior High School in the fictional town of Shiroiwa (Kagawa Prefecture) are gassed on a bus. They awaken in the Okishima Island School on Okishima, an isolated, evacuated island.

series.title: GANGSTA.
series.author: Kohske
series.synopsis: In the city of Ergastulum, a shady ville filled with made men and petty thieves, whores on the make and cops on the take, there are some deeds too dirty for even its jaded inhabitants to touch.

series.title: Bokutachi ga Yarimashita
series.author: Muneyuki Kaneshiro & Hikaru Araki
series.synopsis: Although satisfied with his average lifestyle, Tobio Masubuchi wishes for a long and fun existence, hoping that nothing will get in his way.

series.title: Fist of the North Star
series.author: Yoshiyuki Okamura & Tetsuo Hara
series.synopsis: One day, a wanderer appears out of the wasteland to bring justice to the guilty and hope to the people—a warrior named Ken, a man who bears seven scars upon his chest and holds the secret of a mysterious martial art known as Hokuto Shinken, the Divine Fist of the North Star!

series.title: Azumanga Daioh
series.author: Kiyohiko Azuma
series.synopsis: It's not manga, it's Azumanga! − smart, fun and totally addictive. Created by the iconoclastic Kiyohiko Azuma, Azumanga Daiou is strongly character driven, taking the reader through the daily tribulations of Miss Kurosawa, Miss Yukari, the wild Tomo, hair-triggered Yomi,…

series.title: Sailor Moon
series.author: Naoko Takeuchi
series.synopsis: Usagi Tsukino is a normal girl until she meets up with Luna, a talking cat, who tells her that she is Sailor Moon. As Sailor Moon, Usagi must fight evils and enforce justice, in the name of the Moon and the mysterious Moon Princess.

series.title: Kase-san and...
series.author: Hiromi Takashima
series.synopsis: Yamada may be shy and rather clumsy, but the flower gardens at her school have always brought her happiness. Suddenly, a different sort of beauty catches her eye–the vivacious track star, Kase-san.

series.title: Freesia
series.author: Jiro Matsumoto
series.synopsis: Freesia is set in an alternative Japanese society that is at war, and has passed a law legalizing retaliatory killings. If somebody kills your loved one, you are legally sanctioned to kill, or hire someone to kill, the victimizer.

series.title: My Monster Secret: Actually, I Am…
series.author: Eiji Masuda & Annaliese Christman
series.synopsis: High school student Kuromine Asahi is the kind of guy who literally cannot tell a lie. Whether it’s trying to maintain a poker face in a simple game of cards, or keeping scurrilous gossip to himself, Asahi is a total failure when it comes to the art of deception.

series.title: Loner Life in Another World
series.author: Goji Shoji & Bibi
series.synopsis: IS ONE REALLY THE LONELIEST NUMBER? Haruka is just your average high school loner, minding his own business and keeping to himself as he makes it through his high school career, until one day—he's suddenly sent to another world alongside the rest of his class! Before he knows…

series.title: Helck
series.author: Nanaki Nanao & Annaliese Christman
series.synopsis: After the Demon Lord is slain at the hands of a lone human warrior, humans rejoice over the end of his reign of terror. But an intense tournament of powerful fighters hoping to be crowned the next Demon Lord has drawn in the unlikeliest of contestants—Helck, who claims to hate…

series.title: The Great Jahy Will Not Be Defeated!
series.author: Wakame Konbu
series.synopsis: The Great Jahy, the Dark Realm’s second-in-command, cuts a frightening figure, feared and revered by all. But when a run-in with a magical girl results in the destruction of the precious mana crystal, the Dark Realm falls, transporting the newly puny and powerless Jahy to the…

series.title: Kemono Jihen
series.author: Shou Aimoto
series.synopsis: Inugami is a Tokyo detective who specializes in the occult. One day, answering a call to a remote village leads him to Dorotabo: a peculiar boy nicknamed after a yokai that haunts muddy rice paddies.

series.title: Lone Wolf and Cub
series.author: Kazuo Koike & Goseki Kojima
series.synopsis: An epic samurai adventure of staggering proportions—over 7000 pages—Lone Wolf and Cub (Kozure Okami in Japan) is acknowledged worldwide for the brilliant writing of series creator Kazuo Koike and the groundbreaking cinematic visuals of the late Goseki Kojima, creating…

series.title: Dengeki Daisy
series.author: Kyousuke Motomi
series.synopsis: After orphan Teru Kurebayashi loses her beloved older brother, she finds solace in the messages she exchanges with DAISY, an enigmatic figure who can only be reached through the cell phone her brother left her.

series.title: Hitomi-chan is Shy With Strangers
series.author: Cyorisuke Natsumi
series.synopsis: Tall, busty high schooler Takano Hitomi has shark teeth, a looming presence, and a truly terrifying face. As an upperclassman named Usami Yuu finds out, however, looks can be deceiving.

series.title: I’m in Love with the Villainess
series.author: Shimo Aono & Inori.
series.synopsis: The story of a reincarnated gamer pursuing her villainous lady love at a fantasy girls’ academy! Ordinary office worker Oohashi Rei has just woken up in the body of the protagonist of her favorite girls’ otome game, Revolution.

series.title: Love★Com
series.author: Aya Nakahara
series.synopsis: Rather than bow to the inevitable, Risa and Atsushi join forces to pursue their true objects of affection. But will their budding friendship become something more complex? Note: - Includes the one-shot "Hoshi ni Nattemo Aishiteru" - Includes the one-shot "Bokura no Ibasho".

series.title: It Takes Two Tomorrow, Too
series.author: Suzuyuki
series.synopsis: Yuya Aida (25) and Rio Aihara (28) are in their second month of living together. More than lovers but less than married, they're still more or less content. Notes: - Includes five extra chapters. - Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

series.title: Ookami Shounen wa Kyou mo Uso wo Kasaneru
series.author: namo
series.synopsis: Keitarou Itsuki is a high-school student unhappy about the menacing look of his eyes. Keitarou tries to confess to the girl he likes, Aoi Tokujira, but she rejects him flat out.

series.title: The New Gate
series.author: Shinogi Kazanami & Yoshiyuki Miwa
series.synopsis: THE NEW GATE—an online game transformed into a life-and-death struggle for its players. Thanks to the valiant efforts of Shin, the most powerful of them all, an end to the game and freedom for everyone seemed within reach.

series.title: Love & Lies
series.author: Musawo
series.synopsis: Yukari is dull. He doesn’t even stand out enough to be bullied—he’s just a generally lower-middle-class kid. One day, on the eve of his sixteenth birthday, he confesses to his childhood crush Misaki Takasaki.

series.title: Go! Go! Loser Ranger!
series.author: Negi Haruba
series.synopsis: When the Monster Army invaded Earth thirteen years ago, the Divine Dragon Rangers rose up to stop them! With the war raging on, these great heroes are mankind’s last hope! …or are they? In truth, the invaders were subjugated within a year, forced to continue to crank out a…

series.title: Aria
series.author: Kozue Amano
series.synopsis: On the planet Aqua, a world once known as Mars, Akari Mizunashi has just made her home in the town of Neo-Venezia, a futuristic imitation of the ancient city of Venice.

series.title: An Archdemon's Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf…
series.author: Hako Itagaki & Fuminori Teshima
series.synopsis: Zagan is feared by the masses as an evil sorcerer. Both socially awkward and foulmouthed, he spends his days studying sorcery while beating down any trespassers within his domain.

series.title: Detective Conan
series.author: Gosho Aoyama
series.synopsis: Precocious high school student Jimmy Kudo uses his keen powers of observation and astute intuition to solve mysteries that have left law enforcement officials baffled.

series.title: Tsubasa RESERVoir CHRoNiCLE
series.author: CLAMP
series.synopsis: "The world is a very small place, but for those who know it...it is very, very large. And the world, when it is viewed by those who 'know'— is far larger than just one world can hold!" The famous CLAMP brings back the characters from all their creations for an ultimate…

series.title: Aharen-san is Indecipherable
series.author: Asato Mizu
series.synopsis: Super quiet Aharen Reina isn’t great with personal space—she’s either inches from your face or too far to hear, leaving people totally baffled. But when Raido, the friendly guy seated next to her, helps retrieve a dropped eraser, Aharen suddenly wants to get closer to him.

series.title: Innocent Rouge
series.author: Shinichi Sakamoto & Masakatsu Adachi
series.synopsis: The eve of the French Revolution, 1772— The eldest brother of the Sanson family, Charles-Henri, has grown as an executioner, while his sister, Marie-Joseph, has been living freely in Versailles.

series.title: Classmates
series.author: Asumiko Nakamura
series.synopsis: Hikaru always thought his classmate Rihito was kind of a snob, until he stumbles across Rihito secretly practicing a song in an empty classroom. Hikaru agrees to become Rihito’s music tutor, and with each lesson the two boys grow closer.

series.title: The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic
series.author: Takane Aoto & Kurokata
series.synopsis: Usato, an ordinary high schooler, happens to run into two fellow students after school one rainy day. Suddenly, all three of them are engulfed in a magic circle and transported to a fantasy world.

series.title: The Duke of Death and His Maid
series.author: Inoue
series.synopsis: When the duke was a young boy, a witch made it so that any living thing he touched died. Unable to cope with such a cursed child, his family sent him away to live in an old mansion.

series.title: WITCH WATCH
series.author: Kenta Shinohara
series.synopsis: Morihito, a boy with the strength of an ogre, is about to start living together with his childhood friend Nico, who is training to be a witch. Nico's magic leads to all sorts of unpredictable trouble, and with two teens under one roof...

series.title: Welcome to Ethics Class
series.author: Shiori Amase
series.synopsis: Ethics, or the study of what it means to live, and the principles that shape our sense of right and wrong. It’s a subject you might go your whole life without learning, and never suffer for it. Yet within this classroom lie the truths essential to understanding ourselves.

series.title: Farming Life in Another World
series.author: Yasayuki Tsurugi & Kinosuke Naitou
series.synopsis: After Hiraku dies of a serious illness, God brings him back to life, gives his health and youth back, and sends him to a fantasy world of his choice.

series.title: Angel Densetsu
series.author: Norihiro Yagi
series.synopsis: Seiichirou Kitano is a naive and kind boy with the heart of an angel and the face of a devil. Upon entering his new school he is presumed to be a villainous heroin addict, and unwittingly becomes the leader of the schools thugs, all thanks to his frightening face.

series.title: Handsome Girl and Sheltered Girl
series.author: Mochi Au Lait & majoccoid
series.synopsis: When Okuma Satomi's friend seeks her help wrangling guys for a crossdressing cafe, Satomi winds up with a boyfriend! Sort of.

series.title: Reincarnated as a Sword
series.author: Yuu Tanaka & Tomoo Maruyama
series.synopsis: Reincarnated as a sentient weapon with memories of his past life, but not his name, a magical sword saves a young beastgirl from a life of slavery. Fran, the cat-eared girl, becomes his wielder, and wants only to grow stronger, while the sword wants to know why he is here.

series.title: Another
series.author: Yukito Ayatsuji & Hiro Kiyohara
series.synopsis: In the spring of 1998, Koichi Sakakibara transfers into Class 3-3 at Yomiyama North Middle School. But little does he know...his new class has a horrible secret. When he takes his seat in class for the first day of school, Koichi is unsettled by his fearful classmates.

series.title: After the Rain
series.author: Jun Mayuzuki
series.synopsis: Akira Tachibana. 17 years old, high school junior. Akira, awkward when it comes to expressing her feelings, finds herself secretly falling for the manager of the family restaurant where she works, one Masami Kondo, age 45.

series.title: Machida-kun no Sekai
series.author: Yuki Andou & Erwan Charlès
series.synopsis: Machida-kun seems like the perfect brother, son, and student because he loves people. Helpful when he needs to be, but puts himself down when he feels like a total failure.

series.title: Blood Lad
series.author: Yuuki Kodama
series.synopsis: The vampire Staz is one of the most powerful district bosses in the demon world, fending off everyone who dares challenge him.

series.title: Are You a Landmine, Chihara-san?
series.author: Ryon
series.synopsis: It’s the start of a new semester, and high school junior Kuroki finds himself seated beside the girl everyone whispers about: Mai Chihara.

series.title: Kuzumi-kun, Can't You Read the Room?
series.author: Mosco
series.synopsis: He's plain, he's short, he's boring. And on top of that, Kuzumi-kun can't read the room. Popular high school girl Erika Sakura has for some reason become so stuck on Kuzumi-kun that she can't help it...

series.title: Trigun
series.author: Yasuhiro Nightow
series.synopsis: Much of the damage attributed to "Vash" is caused by the activities of bounty hunters who are after the 60,000,000,000$$ (sixty billion "double dollars") reward on Vash's head for the destruction of a city called July.

series.title: Kuroko's Basketball
series.author: Tadatoshi Fujimaki
series.synopsis: When incoming first-year student Taiga Kagami joins the Seirin High basketball team, he meets Tetsuya Kuroko, a mysterious boy who’s plain beyond words.

series.title: InuYasha
series.author: Rumiko Takahashi
series.synopsis: Kagome is a modern Japanese high school girl. Never the type to believe in myths and legends, her world view dramatically changes when, one day, she's pulled out of her own time and into another! There, in Japan's ancient past, Kagome discovers more than a few of those dusty old…

series.title: Umineko When They Cry Episode 1: Legend of…
series.author: Ryukishi07 & Kei Natsumi
series.synopsis: Each year, the Ushiromiya family gathers at the secluded mansion of its patriarch, the elderly Kinzo. It has been six years since Battler joined his cousins at the annual event, but their happy reunion is overshadowed by worsening weather and an eerie premonition from his…

series.title: My Home Hero
series.author: Naoki Yamakawa & Masashi Asaki
series.synopsis: Tetsuo Tosu is a typical father whose biggest worries are his job and his rebellious daughter, Reika. That is, until he finds a bruise on her face.

series.title: Princess Jellyfish
series.author: Akiko Higashimura & Benoît Lassailly
series.synopsis: Tsukimi Kurashita has a strange fascination with jellyfish. She’s loved them from a young age and has carried that love with her to her new life in the big city of Tokyo.

series.title: Nichijou
series.author: Keiichi Arawi
series.synopsis: Nichijou primarily focuses on the daily antics of a trio of childhood friends—high school girls Mio Naganohara, Yuuko Aioi and Mai Minakami—whose stories soon intertwine with the young genius Hakase Shinonome, her robot caretaker Nano, and their talking cat Sakamoto.

series.title: Overlord
series.author: Kugane Maruyama & Fugin Miyama
series.synopsis: What do you do when your favorite game shuts down? Momonga decided to stay logged in right up until the very end. But when the servers go dark, he finds himself transported into the game world--and he's been transformed into his skeletal avatar from the game, awesome magical…

series.title: Kindergarten Wars
series.author: You Chiba
series.synopsis: Rita is Convict 999, a former legendary assassin who now works at a kindergarten for the children of world leaders. Her job is to protect the schoolchildren from the clutches of would-be assassins sent after them! But even with her overwhelming strength, Rita has a…

series.title: I Belong to the Baddest Girl at School
series.author: Ui Kashima
series.synopsis: "Be mine." Unoki has always been bullied, and high school is no different. Right away, the top troublemaker, Boss Toramaru, makes him her personal errand boy.

series.title: Saiki Kusuo no Ψ-nan
series.author: Shuuichi Asou
series.synopsis: Saiki Kusuo has a wide array of superpowers at his command, including telepathy and telekinesis. This might sound awesome, but, in Kusuo's experience, superpowers are not all they're cracked up to be. He tries to live a normal life, despite his annoying abilities.

series.title: Burn the Witch
series.author: Tite Kubo
series.synopsis: Historically, 72% of all the deaths in London are related to dragons, fantastical beings invisible to the majority of the people. While unknown to most, some people have been standing up to these dragons.

series.title: Black Torch
series.author: Tsuyoshi Takaki
series.synopsis: Jiro Azuma is descended from of a long line of shinobi, and he also can talk to animals. One day, he rescues a very unique black cat named Rago, a supernatural being, and is dragged into a secret supernatural war. Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

series.title: Pokémon Adventures
series.author: Hidenori Kusaka & Satoshi Yamamoto
series.synopsis: Red is just a normal kid living in the rural Pallet Town, when he decides to go out on his own adventure, along with his rival since childhood, Green. In this world of Pokemon, he makes many friends, humans and Pokemon alike. However, all is not well.

series.title: Akira Failing in Love
series.author: Shinta Harekawa
series.synopsis: Akira returns to the countryside for high school with a plan to win the heart of her childhood crush! They're both fools in love… because she's too dense to figure out he likes her back!

series.title: No Longer Human
series.author: Usamaru Furuya & Osamu Dazai
series.synopsis: Set in modern day Tokyo, Dazai's tale details the life of a young man originally from a well-off family from Japan's far north. Yozo Oba is a troubled soul incapable of revealing his true self to others.

series.title: Hirayasumi
series.author: Keigo Shinzo
series.synopsis: With a carefree outlook on life, Hiroto knows better than anyone that slowing down is sometimes the best way to move forward. At 29 years old, carefree Hiroto Ikuta doesn’t have a girlfriend, a full-time job, or a plan for the future—and he couldn’t be happier.

series.title: Talentless Nana
series.author: Loose Boy & Iori Furuya
series.synopsis: An academy on an island in unnavigable waters. There, students trained tirelessly, to fight back against the enemies of humanity. The protagonist, a student newly transferred there, also sets out with the intention of eradicating all enemies of humankind.

series.title: Hope You're Happy, Lemon
series.author: Mizuki Kishikawa
series.synopsis: Sunao Akiyoshi thought he’d left heartbreak behind after swearing off love in junior high. His first love, Lemon Nishikawa, shattered his trust by admitting to cheating on him with multiple guys.

series.title: I Had That Same Dream Again
series.author: Yoru Sumino & Izumi Kirihara
series.synopsis: An unhappy girl who engages in self-harm, a woman ostracized by society, and an old woman looking to live out her twilight years in peace–what could three such different people have in common? That’s what grade schooler Nanoka Koyanagi is trying to find out.

series.title: Barakamon
series.author: Satsuki Yoshino
series.synopsis: For a certain reason, a handsome, young calligrapher by the name of Seishuu Handa uproots himself and moves to an island on the westernmost edge of Japan. "Sensei," as he comes to be known, is a city boy through and through, and has never experienced rural life until now.

series.title: Mr. Paper Bag is in Love
series.author: Riko Amaebi
series.synopsis: A stalker? A pervert? No, no. I'm just a college boy who is single-mindedly in love with someone. It's just...I live my life wearing a paper bag on my head, which makes people look at me strangely on campus.

series.title: I Hear the Sunspot
series.author: Yuki Fumino
series.synopsis: Because of a hearing disability, Kouhei is often misunderstood and has trouble integrating into life on campus, so he learns to keep his distance. That is until he meets the outspoken and cheerful Taichi. He tells Kouhei that his hearing loss is not his fault.

series.title: Attack on Titan: No Regrets
series.author: Konkichi & Gan Sunaaku
series.synopsis: The young Erwin Smith is a rising star in the Survey Corps, humanity's only hope of defeating the man-eating monsters known as Titans. Ruthless and dispassionate, Erwin's mind is devoted to strategies and intrigue.

series.title: Skip Beat!
series.author: Yoshiki Nakamura
series.synopsis: Kyoko Mogami followed her true love Sho to Tokyo to support him while he made it big as an idol. But he's casting her out now that he's famous! Kyoko won't suffer in silence--she's going to get her sweet revenge by beating Sho in show biz!

series.title: The Faraway Paladin
series.author: Mutsumi Okubashi & Kanata Yanagino
series.synopsis: A man dies alone after living a stagnant and fruitless life—but that's not where his story ends, as a boy named William is born into a land of fantasy and magic.

series.title: GREEN BLOOD
series.author: Masasumi Kakizaki
series.synopsis: The end of the civil war signaled the start of the industrial revolution in the United States and immigrants from all over the world traveled to find their American dream. But what awaited the majority of them was poverty, discrimination, and hopelessness.

series.title: Magical Girl Site
series.author: Kentarou Satou & Meaghan Tucker
series.synopsis: Asagiri Aya has a difficult life. The middle school girl the target of cruel bullying at school by day, and violent abuse at home by night. One day, while surfing the web, she came across a creepy figure who granted her a gift of magic power… Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

series.title: My Status as an Assassin Obviously Exceeds…
series.author: Matsuri Akai & Hiroyuki Aigamo
series.synopsis: When Akira’s class is magically summoned to another world, he and his classmates are awarded fantastical powers–but while one of them is lucky enough to become a true Hero, Akira becomes a mere Assassin.

series.title: Tower Dungeon
series.author: Tsutomu Nihei
series.synopsis: An evil sorcerer slays the king and takes over his body, kidnapping the princess and spiriting her away to the legendary Dragon Tower. The Royal Guard is rebuffed in their attempt to rescue her, and to replace the wounded, a young farmhand named Yuva is called up into service.

series.title: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day
series.author: Nachi Aono
series.synopsis: At the mysterious orphanage where Sheena lives, death is nothing new to its residents—girls who no longer have families of their own, who are raised as weapons of war, taught to kill and take the lives of others without batting an eye.

series.title: The Klutzy Class Monitor and the Girl with…
series.author: Takuma Yokota
series.synopsis: Sakuradaimon-kun is an overserious class monitor whose duty is to make sure other students are following the school dress code. His primary target is Kohinata-san, a troublemaker with light hair and a miniskirt.

series.title: The Voynich Hotel
series.author: Sayman Dowman
series.synopsis: Welcome to the Voynich Hotel, a rundown resort located on an all but deserted island in the South Pacific. Owned by former Mexican wrestler Kandre Umeda, the hotel is maintained by two mysterious maids, Elena and Beluna, as well as a homicidal chef named Amelia.

series.title: Welcome to the Ballroom
series.author: Tomo Takeuchi & Kévin Druelle
series.synopsis: Fujita has drifted through middle school aimlessly, unable to find friends or anything that can hold his attention. Then, one day, he's attacked by a gang and saved by a mysterious man.

series.title: Say "I Love You".
series.author: Kanae Hazuki
series.synopsis: Mei Tachibana has no friends—and she doesn't need them! Ever since her "friends" betrayed her in elementary school, she's sworn off friendship entirely. All it leads to is betrayal and heartbreak, and she's well enough on her own.

series.title: Tsubaki-chou Lonely Planet
series.author: Mika Yamamori
series.synopsis: Fumi Oono, second-year high-school student. Stuck with the debts of her father, she needs a job—fast. While she did indeed manage to find one as a housekeeper for THE Akatsuki Kibikino, it leaves much to be desired.

series.title: After God
series.author: Sumi Eno
series.synopsis: Japan has been invaded by Gods, leaving giant Danger Zones where once were cityscapes. While patrolling the area, Anti-God researcher Tokinaga discovers Kamikura Waka looking forlornly through the protective fence. In her eyes, he spots something deep and dangerous.

series.title: Wake up, Sleeping Beauty
series.author: Megumi Morino
series.synopsis: Despite being a scaredy-cat and crybaby, high schooler Tetsu Misato finds himself working at the eerie estate on the hill, where Shizu—the only child of the Karasawa family—is secreted away.

series.title: I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World and…
series.author: Miku & Kazuomi Minatogawa
series.synopsis: It’s time for the Ousei Academy camping trip! Yuuya and his classmates head into the wilderness, where they’ll need to build shelters, find food, and otherwise fend for themselves.

series.title: Ragna Crimson
series.author: Daiki Kobayashi
series.synopsis: In this action-packed dark fantasy, humanity lives under the threat of annihilation by immensely powerful dragons. The dragon hunter Ragna embarks on a revenge-fueled quest to eliminate that threat once and for all!

series.title: Make the Exorcist Fall in Love
series.author: Aruma Arima & Masuku Fukayama
series.synopsis: A boy was chosen by god to become the world's strongest exorcist and to face deadly demons in battle. Burdened with the fate of humanity, all he really wants to do is quietly bake sweets, when one day a certain girl enters his life… A story of love and hope blooming during a…

series.title: Remina
series.author: Junji Itou
series.synopsis: An unknown planet emerges from inside a wormhole, and its discoverer, Dr. Oguro, christens the body “Remina” after his own daughter. His finding is met with great fanfare, and Remina herself rises to fame.

series.title: I Have a Crush at Work
series.author: Akamaru Enomoto
series.synopsis: Yui Mitsuya and Masugu Tateishi aren't just any coworkers-they totally have the hots for each other. His helpful yet humble attitude makes her giddy, and her cuteness leaves him grinning like a fool.

series.title: Boku no Kanojo wa Saikou desu!
series.author: Iori & Takami Takada
series.synopsis: The many different stories between two lovers -- a normal young man and a outgoing, passionate friend-come-lover.

series.title: A Condition Called Love
series.author: Megumi Morino
series.synopsis: Hotaru is a 16-year-old high school first-year who has always been ambivalent about love, preferring instead to have a lively life with her family and friends.

series.title: 365 Days to the Wedding
series.author: Tamiki Wakaki & Carlo Vanstiphout
series.synopsis: Takuya and Rika are coworkers in a travel agency in Tokyo. They’re both single, but they don’t mind, since they’re introverts with fulfilling lives at home.

series.title: Silver Spoon
series.author: Hiromu Arakawa
series.synopsis: Defying the expectations of family and teachers, Yuugo Hachiken chooses to leave the city and enroll at Ooezo Agricultural High School.

series.title: My Love Mix-Up!
series.author: Wataru Hinekure & Aruko
series.synopsis: Mistaken identity leads to a blossoming romance between two boys. Aoki has a crush on Hashimoto, the girl in the seat next to him in class. But he despairs when he borrows her eraser and sees she’s written the name of another boy—Ida—on it.

series.title: No. 6
series.author: Atsuko Asano & Hinoki Kino
series.synopsis: For Shion, an elite student in the technologically sophisticated city No. 6, life is carefully choreographed. School, study, and the occasional visit with his friend and classmate Safu.

series.title: Campfire Cooking in Another World with My…
series.author: Ren Eguchi & Akagishi K
series.synopsis: Tsuyoshi Mukouda was nothing special in modern Japan, so when he was summoned to a world of swordplay and sorcery, he thought he was ready for the adventure of a lifetime.

series.title: A Tropical Fish Yearns for Snow
series.author: Makoto Hagino
series.synopsis: Konatsu is doing her best to adapt to her new school, but being required to join a club has introduced additional pressures. Her friendly classmate Kaede invites her to join the Home Ec Club, but Konatsu hasn’t even had time to consider which club she’s interested in.

series.title: Chikan Otoko
series.author: Takuma Yokota
series.synopsis: Based off a real story which was posted on 2ch, Molester Man is the story of how Molester Man is mistaken for a stalker by Miss Understanding, and how they overcome their personal challenges while slowly growing closer to each other. Notes: Includes chapters 14.5 and 21.5

series.title: Tsumiki Ogami's Not-So-Ordinary Life
series.author: Miyu Morishita
series.synopsis: Yutaka Shinso is constantly worried about what other people think of him. Hoping to turn over a new leaf, he changes high schools, but there’s something strange afoot: vampires, ogres, and all manner of supernatural beings walk the halls! Yutaka is particularly drawn to Tsumiki…

series.title: Magus of the Library
series.author: Mitsu Izumi
series.synopsis: A story about a poor boy swept away by a kind library mage and the (literal) magic of reading, Magus of the Library is a beautifully-drawn, spirited fantasy adventure, like a Fullmetal Alchemist for all ages! In the small village of Amun lives a poor boy named Theo.

series.title: Dusk Maiden of Amnesia
series.author: Maybe
series.synopsis: Legend states that the ghost of a student who died at Seikyou Private Academy still haunts the grounds to this day... A truth that first year student Teiichi uncovers when he stumbles into that very ghost, Yuuko! However, with no memories of her previous life, she enlists the…

series.title: The Angel Next Door Spoils Me Rotten
series.author: Wan Shibata & Saeki-san
series.synopsis: Amane Fujimiya lives alone in a messy apartment—right next door to Mahiru Shiina, a veritable "angel" who's the smartest, prettiest girl at school.

series.title: Daemons of the Shadow Realm
series.author: Hiromu Arakawa
series.synopsis: In a remote mountain village under the watchful eyes of two stone guardians, the young Yuru contentedly lives off the land while staying close to the only family he has left—Asa, his precious twin sister.

series.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
series.author: Kazuki Takahashi
series.synopsis: 10th grader Yugi spent most of his time alone playing games--until he solved the Millennium Puzzle, a mysterious Egyptian artifact! Possessed by the puzzle, Yugi becomes Yu-Gi-Oh, the King of Games, and challenges evil-doers to the Shadow Games--weird games with high stakes and…

series.title: ZETMAN
series.author: Masakazu Katsura
series.synopsis: Jin is a strange kid with an angel mark on his hand. He lives a poor but peaceful life with his grandfather, along with the other destitute and abandoned vagabonds near the river.

series.title: Lunar Legend Tsukihime
series.author: Shounen Sasaki & Type-Moon
series.synopsis: Shiki Tohno sustained a life threatening injury as a child, and due to that incident he was sent away from the Tohno household and was given to a relative to be raised.

series.title: I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl…
series.author: Rin Ono & Takata
series.synopsis: Maki Maehara is always on his own at school. He has no friends or hobbies others share, and he doesn't expect the upcoming academic year to be any different, even surrounded by new faces.

series.title: Run Away With Me, Girl
series.author: Battan
series.synopsis: Maki's first love was her high school classmate, a girl named Midori. But Midori broke up with Maki at graduation, saying they were now "too old to be fooling around dating girls." Ten years later, Maki still can’t get Midori off her mind, and when the two women reconnect after…

series.title: Osoraku Kanojo wa Ore no Aniki wo Neratteru
series.author: Maruno Ise
series.synopsis: A high school guy who doesn't trust girls anymore has been tricked too many times by girls who just wanted to get close to his good-looking older brother. After all that, he decides he’ll never trust a girl again.

series.title: Glasses With a Chance of Delinquent
series.author: Naruki
series.synopsis: Momose has always longed for a peaceful high school life. She wants nothing to do with hoodlums, delinquents, or troublemakers. When she meets Ichikura, an inconspicuous black-haired boy with glasses, he looks like a normal, nice guy.

series.title: Bonnouji
series.author: Aki★ Eda
series.synopsis: Fate brings two people who live in the same condo together on a typical afternoon. Ozawa (26) has just broken up with her boyfriend of five years and was in the process of trying to rebuild her life when she meets Oyamada who lives a couple floors below her.

series.title: Yugami-kun ni wa Tomodachi ga Inai
series.author: Jun Sakura
series.synopsis: The story of the comedy manga revolves around Yuuji Yugami and Chihiro Watanuki, who sit next to each other in class. Unfortunately for Chihiro the transfer student, Yuuji is weird... extremely weird.

series.title: Senryuu Shoujo
series.author: Masakuni Igarashi
series.synopsis: Yukishiro Nanako is a cute, cheerful high school girl with one peculiar trait – instead of verbal communication, she writes senryu (a type of haiku) poems to relay her thoughts. Together with ex-delinquent Busujima Eiji, they are budding freshmen of the school’s Literature Club.

series.title: This Monster Wants to Eat Me
series.author: Sai Naekawa
series.synopsis: “I’ve come to eat you.” So softly utters the mermaid Shiori as she emerges from the sea and takes high school girl Hinako by the hand. Hinako lives alone in a town by the sea and possesses an unusually delicious body that is irresistible to nearby monsters.

series.title: How to Grill Our Love
series.author: Shiori Hanatsuka
series.synopsis: Dating can be tough when you nerd out over barbecue. Kenta, a practical pitmaster, looks for a grill-friend in Chihiro, an aloof and faultless business babe…or is she? Scared of being rejected for who they really are, the two of them find comfort in food and each other…and all…

series.title: Chainsaw Man
series.author: Tatsuki Fujimoto
series.synopsis: A broke devil hunter merges with his chainsaw-devil dog and is recruited into a government unit with very strange bosses.

series.title: Sky Courier
series.author: Aoi Kumohara
series.synopsis: A paper-kite courier carries letters across a city of floating islands at night, and learns that every parcel holds somebody's whole story. A demonstration series for this prototype.
